rank_frequency: Rank-frequency (log-log) of relation, new-target and subject categories in each eligible pool (zsRE 10,420; CounterFact 20,091; MQuAKE 6,043 single-hop items). zsRE has no relation ids. Straight segments are not a power-law test.
frozen_surprisal: Frozen GPT-2 small: teacher-forced per-token NLL of the taught (new) target on the 300 edit prompts of realization 0, per dataset; histogram and empirical CCDF. No cap, no adaptation.
tail_shapes_probe_loss: Generalized-Pareto shape fitted to exceedances of per-token target surprisal above its P95, pooled over all target tokens (terminator excluded) of the edit/paraphrase/unseen prompts (new target) and locality/near-miss prompts (true target) for each model at 300 edits (frozen: no memory); 200 item-group bootstrap draws. Finite-range fits, not asymptotic classes.
deciles_counterfact_edit: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on counterfact edit prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_counterfact_paraphrase: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on counterfact paraphrase prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_counterfact_unseen: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on counterfact unseen prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_mquake_edit: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on mquake edit prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_mquake_paraphrase: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on mquake paraphrase prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_mquake_unseen: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on mquake unseen prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_zsre_edit: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on zsre edit prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_zsre_paraphrase: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on zsre paraphrase prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
deciles_zsre_unseen: Mean paired gain over frozen GPT-2 by frozen-difficulty decile on zsre unseen prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon; BP and ePC readers as seed means over three paired seeds; grey: ePC minus BP. Deciles are fixed by the frozen model's per-token NLL; 95 % intervals from 500 item-group bootstrap draws.
cvar_A_B: Two different worst-case summaries at 300 edits: (A) each model's own CVaR95 of per-token target loss; (B) every model's mean loss on the same fixed set, the 5 % of cases hardest for frozen GPT-2. Families: edit, paraphrase, unseen (new target).
paired_pc_minus_bp: Paired per-probe differences of per-token target loss, ePC-trained minus BP-trained reader of the same seed, on paraphrase prompts (new target) at the 300-edit horizon. Positive values favour BP.
write_norms: Relative write magnitude (||W_m|| / ||h_m|| at the prediction position, maximum over the three sites and over the scored target positions) against frozen difficulty and against the paired gain; edit and paraphrase prompts, new target, 300 edits, all six readers. Zero means the reader abstained.
mquake_pcreader: MQuAKE realization 0, order 100, 300 edits: paraphrase retention (RET-GS, 300 items) and the registered composition endpoint (all three multi-hop questions correct, 80 cases) for the six saved readers, evaluated in this study.
harm_survival_pcreader: Ordinary-text harm (loss with cap minus loss without, same prefix) survival curves for the BP- and ePC-trained readers at 300 edits: zsRE and CounterFact from the frozen record, MQuAKE from this study's supplemental evaluations. Zero survival omitted on the log axis; curves are not power-law tests.
